channelList.description: On key press emit a note-on carrying MIDI pitch and velocity (also modified by the pitch-bend wheel value); on release emit note-off. The oscillator bank sets each oscillator's base frequency from the pitch, applies bend offset, and starts/stops the tone.

Key press sends a gate-on trigger and key release sends gate-off; the envelope starts its attack/decay/sustain stages on gate-on and enters release on gate-off, and passes mod-wheel value through as an intensity input.
Continuously outputs the summed/mixed oscillator+sub+noise audio signal as the input to the filter's processing stage.
Continuously outputs the filtered audio signal as the input to the first effect in the effects chain.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: ADSR Envelope->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: Continuously emits the envelope's current amplitude value (0-1 scaled by amount) which the master stage applies as the per-note gain, directly driving how the output level and meter rise and fall over the note's life.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: LFO Modulation Panel->Synthesizer: Oscillator Bank
channelList.description: When destination = pitch/PWM, streams a bipolar oscillating value scaled by depth that the oscillators add to frequency or pulse width each frame.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: LFO Modulation Panel->Synthesizer: Filter Section
channelList.description: When destination = cutoff, streams a bipolar oscillating value scaled by depth that the filter adds to its cutoff frequency each frame.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Effects Rack->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: Continuously outputs the fully processed stereo audio as the input to the master volume/pan/limiter stage.
On load, pushes the saved oscillator parameters so the bank restores waveforms, pitch, detune, mix, sub, noise, and unison.
On load, pushes the saved filter type, cutoff, resonance, drive, keytrack, and envelope amount.
On load, pushes the saved attack, decay, sustain, release, and amount values.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Preset Browser->Synthesizer: LFO Modulation Panel
channelList.description: On load, pushes the saved LFO rate, waveform, depth, sync, and destination.
On load, pushes saved per-effect parameters, wet/dry, bypass states, and chain order.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Preset Browser->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: On load, pushes saved master volume, pan, and limiter state.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Step Sequencer & Arpeggiator->Synthesizer: Performance Keyboard
channelList.description: While playing, emits scheduled note-on/note-off events (pitch, velocity, timing derived from the grid, arp mode, rate, gate length, and swing); the keyboard highlights those keys and forwards the notes to the oscillator/envelope voice path.
